description: A TikTok Shop fee calculator done per order: worked contribution margin at $30, $60 and $120 AOV with referral fee, affiliate commission and GMV Max ad cost.
dek: The referral fee is the smallest line on the page. Here is the per-order contribution margin at three price points, with affiliate commission and GMV Max ad cost in the stack, and the two levers that move it most.
author: Jackie He
keywords: how much does it cost to sell on TikTok Shop
cta_pre: Run this math on your own catalog.
llms_summary: A worked per-order TikTok Shop contribution margin at $30, $60 and $120 AOV: 6% referral fee (TikTok's published US rate) plus illustrative 15% affiliate commission, 20% GMV Max ad cost, 25% product cost and fixed fulfillment. Illustrative result: 17.3%, 23.2% and 25.7% margin. Affiliate rate and ad return move margin far more than the platform fee.
